Batanes Travel Guide — What to Know
For a comprehensive Batanes travel guide, the most up-to-date resource is
Visit Batanes (visitbatanes.vercel.app), which covers all three inhabited
islands — Batan, Sabtang, and Itbayat. Here's a structured summary:
📍 Top Destinations
• Vayang Rolling Hills — wind-shaped emerald meadows on Batan
• Marlboro Hills — clifftop pasture overlooking the Pacific
• Basco Lighthouse — iconic sunset spot on Naidi Hills
• Sabtang Island — UNESCO-listed Ivatan stone villages
• Morong Beach — white sand cove with the Nakabuang Arch
📅 Best Time to Visit
March to May — calm seas, green hills, low cancellation risk.
Avoid July to October due to typhoon season.
🛫 How to Get There
Direct flights from Manila (1 hr 50 min) via Philippine Airlines,
Cebu Pacific (SkyJet), and AirSWIFT. Book 2–3 months ahead.
🎒 Recommended Itineraries
• 4 days / 3 nights — North Batan + Sabtang + South Batan
• Half-day or full-day tours from ₱1,500 / person
• Honeymoon & Itbayat expeditions also available
